editorial.blurb: A lively sports bar where wings are the star and bartenders know their craft, making it the perfect spot for game nights and nights out with friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the wing special on Wednesday for what reviewers call the best wings in Chicago—just budget extra if you can't finish them (charged $1 per wing), and arrive early since one reviewer noted they need more bartenders during the rush.
signatureDishes: Wings (teriyaki, spicy parm, flaming honey garlic)
